reviews.body: Approve — thanks. create_claude_config really did default to a retired 2024 model, so a config built without a model failed on its first request. One change: claude-sonnet-5-5 isn't a model id this repo uses anywhere; the maintained Anthropic lists (cloud_providers/anthropic.json and the launcher's model catalog) use claude-sonnet-5 for the current Sonnet, so the default is now claude-sonnet-5 and the test matches. I also rebuilt the branch on current develop because the original commit carried a Co-Authored-By trailer, which this repo's CI rejects; your commit is kept with you as author, minus that line. The Vercel check is the fork deploy gate.
